name: Yoake Akino
source:
Yoake Eimu older sister.
She doesn't show her emotions and maintains a cold attitude towards everyone except "Him."
She has sworn complete loyalty to "Him."

[From [url=http://www.t-apricot.jp/products/aya/chara.html]ApRicoT[/url]]
